budgets.about: Cert budgets (scripts/studio/cert.mjs). Hardware numbers follow the Dreamcast: ~3M polygons a second is ~60k triangles a frame at 50-60 fps. Words count visible words; numbers are free. Over budget warns; STUDIO_STRICT=1 fails.
